messages:
alex: Morning — standup: what I did: rolled out kv-eviction tweak to canary (pool-3), verified reduced mem pressure; fixed a bad logging hotpath.

maria: Nice — saw fewer OOM spikes on pool-3, latency looks stable but p99 spiked by ~30ms during burst window at 10:15.

alex: Yep saw that. I think batcher backpressure kicked in briefly. Looking into batch sizing at high-concurrency.

jordan: Quick blocker: I'm waiting on the canary config PR review (#482) — needs a second approval for the autoscale override. @maria can you take a look?

maria: Will do after standup.

sam: FYI oncall noticed alert flapping for cache-hit-rate on rtv-prod, tied to the kv eviction rollout? logs show eviction churn around that window.

alex: Thanks @sam — that matches. I've added a temporary suppress rule in alerting for 2h while we observe. If it persists we'll revert the tweak.

deploy-bot: Deploy 17685 applied to canary pool-3: kv-evict=aggressive -> active. See: https://deploys/redwood/17685

alex: Quick note — if you want to test locally, here's the repro command:
```
kubectl exec -it svc/rtv-worker -- /bin/sh -c "loadtest --concurrency 200 --duration 60s"
```

jordan: For the p99 spike: can we capture a heap profile and tracer spans? I can add a short profiler job if we agree.

maria: Yes, run profiler for 5m during the next peak; add header `X-Debug-Trace: svc-kv` so traces are grouped.

sam: I've filed a short oncall follow-up ticket: OPS-2783, linked to the alert noise and removed reaction spam. Will update with screenshots.

alex: Today: keep canary running, gather heap/traces, open PR for adaptive batcher logic. Blocker: need a vetted threshold for eviction to avoid churn — @jordan any heuristics?

jordan: Heuristic: keep eviction threshold above 30% churn per 5m window; if churn >30% degrade to conservative eviction. I'll sketch a small RFC in the ticket.

maria: Also pinging docs: add a short note in runbook about temporary suppress windows and canary rollback steps.

alex: Thanks — tagging this thread in OPS-2783. If anyone sees regression, ping @oncall immediately and react with :eyes:.

sam: acked. I'll post a small dashboard tile for quick view.

maria: Closing my loop — will review PR and run profiler after lunch.

alex: Ok wrapping — will post results in an hour. Thanks.
